globalRules: No Supabase auth session, refresh token, password hash, MFA factor, recovery token, service role secret, or publishable key may enter Zhangak artifacts.
Legacy user authentication requires a reviewed Zhangak password-reset and activation flow; do not translate bcrypt or encrypted_password values into the scrypt password_hash column.
Generated numeric Zhangak IDs are never assumed to equal legacy IDs. Use a disposable, run-scoped staging ID map after a separate importer has been approved.
Historic assessment attempts, XP, ranks, and client-authored scores are archive-only until item-level provenance and server-authoritative invariants are independently verified.
Supabase Storage object URLs are not portable. Re-host reviewed files and create new Zhangak-owned URLs before importing references.
Tables with no current Zhangak schema are archive-only and must not be silently dropped or force-fit into unrelated tables.

mappings.reviewNote: Blocked until an explicit password-reset/activation schema and migration are reviewed. Password hashes and active Supabase sessions are never imported.
Confirm exact source columns and who created each row before mapping to the Zhangak courses contract.
Teacher, student, course, capacity, delivery mode, and historical membership rules must all pass target validation.
Content URLs must be re-hosted or removed; progress is imported only after student and lesson maps reconcile.
Map exactly four options, correct-answer semantics, publication state, and question ordering in an isolated review environment.
Migration may carry provenance only. Verify current tuition, scores, deadlines, and official URLs before activating catalog rows.
